description: Fetches one comment by its id: Reddit's native t1 comment node (body, author, score, parent, permalink). A comment that does not exist is a 404. Standard read price. Example: id='abc123'.

id.description: The comment id, the part after t1_ (e.g. 'abc123'). Required (path parameter).

name: reddit_comment_by_id
title: Get Comment by ID
